abstract_sentences.text: Reasoning models have made rapid progress on many benchmarks involving math, code, and science.

evidence.anchor: Reasoning models have made rapid progress

abstract_sentences.text: Yet, there are still many open questions about the best training recipes for reasoning since state-of-the-art models often rely on proprietary datasets with little to no public information available.

evidence.anchor: many open questions; proprietary datasets

abstract_sentences.text: To address this, the goal of the OpenThoughts project is to create open-source datasets for training reasoning models.

evidence.anchor: goal of the OpenThoughts project

abstract_sentences.text: Our OpenThoughts2-1M dataset led to OpenThinker2-32B, the first model trained on public reasoning data to match DeepSeek-R1-Distill-32B on standard reasoning benchmarks such as AIME and LiveCodeBench.

evidence.anchor: OpenThoughts2-1M dataset led to OpenThinker2-32B

abstract_sentences.text: We then improve our dataset further by systematically investigating each step of our data generation pipeline with 1,000+ controlled experiments, which led to OpenThoughts3.

evidence.anchor: 1,000+ controlled experiments

abstract_sentences.text: Scaling the pipeline to 1.2M examples and using QwQ-32B as teacher yields our OpenThinker3-7B model, which achieves state-of-the-art results: 53% on AIME 2025, 51% on LiveCodeBench 06/24-01/25, and 54% on GPQA Diamond – improvements of 15.3, 17.2, and 20.5 percentage points compared to the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B.

evidence.anchor: 1.2M examples; 53% on AIME 2025

abstract_sentences.text: All of our datasets and models are available on openthoughts.ai.

experimental_design.name: predeclared_research_questions
experimental_design.description: 没有编号 RQ、预注册假设或预先指定效应阈值；作者以“best dataset produces the highest-performing model”作为操作性目标。

evidence.anchor: The best dataset is the one that produces the highest-performing model

experimental_design.name: controlled_training_unit
experimental_design.description: 每个 data strategy 生成 31,600 个样本，并在同一个 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上微调，以比较策略而非 base model。

evidence.anchor: generate 31,600 data points for each data strategy
finetune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct

experimental_design.name: question_source_coverage
experimental_design.description: code、math、science 分别覆盖 27、21、14 个 question sources；需要 LLM 生成的 source 使用 GPT-4o-mini，回答统一由 DeepSeek-R1 生成。

evidence.anchor: 27 different question sources for code questions, 21 sources for math, and 14 sources for science
use GPT-4o-mini for all sources that we generate
use DeepSeek-R1 to generate responses for each question

experimental_design.name: primary_benchmark_suite
experimental_design.description: 主评测为 8 个任务，math 为 AIME24/AMC23/MATH500，code 为 CodeElo/CodeForces/LCB 05/23-05/24，science 为 GPQA Diamond/JEEBench；以跨域 average 选阶段 winner。

evidence.anchor: Per domain, these benchmarks are
score each model based on average performance on these eight tasks

experimental_design.name: held_out_benchmark_suite
experimental_design.description: AIME 2025、HMMT 02/25、HLE MCQ 与 LCB 06/24-01/25 在 pipeline 实验后才测量，用于 generalization 检验。

evidence.anchor: held out set of benchmarks, which are only measured once pipeline experiments are over
HMMT, AIME 2025, LiveCodeBench 06/24-01/25, and HLE are held out

experimental_design.name: stage_selection_rule
experimental_design.description: 每阶段按三域 average benchmark score 选择 top-performing approach，再把选择带入下一阶段；DeepSeek-R1 是默认 teacher。

evidence.anchor: At each pipeline step, we select the top-performing approach based on the average benchmark score across all domains
DeepSeek-R1 is the default teacher model unless specified otherwise

experimental_design.name: training_framework_and_hyperparameters
experimental_design.description: 训练使用 LlamaFactory 与 DeepSpeed v3，AdamW、cosine learning rate、0.1 warmup、zero weight decay；不同数据规模使用四组 LR/batch/epoch/packing。

evidence.anchor: Our training is done using LlamaFactory
train on DeepSpeed v3 with a cosine learning rate
Settings for different hyperparameter sets

experimental_design.name: generation_configuration
experimental_design.description: 统一 generation 配置为 temperature 0.7、top_p 1.0、max_new_tokens 32,768。

evidence.anchor: temperature = 0.7, top_p = 1.0, and max_new_tokens = 32,768

experimental_design.name: replication_and_aggregation
experimental_design.description: AIME24/AIME25/AMC23/HMMT 10 次，LCB 6 次，CodeForces/CodeElo/GPQA/JEE/HLE 3 次，MATH500 单次 500 题；报告 mean accuracy 与 SEM。

evidence.anchor: mean accuracy and SEM over 10 iterations
MATH500: single pass evaluation on the full 500 sample set

experimental_design.name: random_seeds
experimental_design.description: 报告 repeated iteration 数，但没有给出具体随机 seed、seed-level dispersion 或每次训练的独立模型清单。

evidence.anchor: mean accuracy and SEM over repeated runs

experimental_design.name: controls_and_matching
experimental_design.description: 逐阶段保持其余 pipeline 固定；答案过滤先生成 63,200 responses，再抽取 31,600 个 pair 以控制样本数。

evidence.anchor: isolating the effect of a given strategy while keeping the rest of the pipeline constant
first generate 63,200 answers

experimental_design.name: decontamination_control
experimental_design.description: 对 training/evaluation sample 使用 normalized Indel similarity 75% 阈值或共享 13-gram；人工 testbed 为 3,092 contaminated 与 3,000 clean。

evidence.anchor: similarity of 75% between our two strings to indicate contamination
3092 contaminated samples and 3000 uncontaminated samples

experimental_design.name: failure判定
experimental_design.description: 没有独立 failure threshold、最小效应或正式模型选择检验；实际规则是按平均 benchmark score 排名并选 winner。

evidence.anchor: select the top-performing approach based on the average benchmark score across all domains

experimental_design.name: evaluation_tool
experimental_design.description: 所有 benchmark 评测通过 Evalchemy，多 GPU 分片并缓存 long-CoT completions。

evidence.anchor: All model evaluations across benchmarks were performed using Evalchemy
cache full model completions for long chain-of-thought tasks

experimental_design.name: compute_budget
experimental_design.description: QwQ-32B annotation 为 22,000 H100 GPU hours，OpenThinker3-7B 单次训练为 25,000 A100 GPU hours，单次评测 32 GPU-hours，每个 31.6K dataset API 约 $300。

evidence.anchor: Annotating OpenThoughts3-1.2M with QwQ-32B required 22,000 H100 GPU hours
annotating each 31,600-size dataset cost roughly $300

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 reasoning SFT data curation 变成六阶段、可逐步选择的生产管线，固定 base/样本规模/评测，先在 31.6K 控制成本下选 winner，再扩展到 OpenThoughts3-1.2M 和 OpenThinker3-7B。 [evidence: p.3–9, §3–4]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留六阶段候选、31,600 控制、八个主任务、held-out 设计、Tables 2–7、Figure 2/3、最终域配比与 Table 1 结果，读者可复核 recipe 决策方向。 [evidence: p.3–10, Tables 1–7]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整 source/filter/answer 组合、训练与 Evalchemy 参数、去污染、prompt、compute、license、safety、AIW、负面 ablation 和 Tables 31–48 移到 Appendix A–P。迁移保留了配方可读性，却提高了逐项复现与审计成本。 [evidence: p.20–72, Appendices A–P]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 先画可枚举决策点，Figure 3 再画最终样本流；每个阶段以比较表和 Takeaway 推进，Table 1 同时放主域与 held-out 结果，公式仅保留去污染/dedup 所需定义。 [evidence: p.1–2, p.4, p.9, p.25, p.59]
final_judgment.largest_gap: QwQ-32B 的“更好 teacher”只由下游 utility 支撑，不能直接等同于 teacher 的内在 benchmark 能力或 trace correctness。顺序锁定、跨域平均、seed/保留率/完整实验轨迹和多重比较缺失，削弱阶段级因果解释。 [evidence: p.3–9, p.24, p.39, p.54–72]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对大型数据 recipe 使用顺序决策链，每个节点固定其余条件，报告 winner、长尾组合、held-out 结果和不利边界。 [evidence: p.3–10, p.65–72]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于有可训练代理模型、可重复下游评测和高成本数据生产的 SFT pipeline；不能单独推出 RL、curriculum、不同 base/teacher objective 或部署安全的普遍结论。 [evidence: p.10, p.29–30, p.40, p.44]

statistical_analysis.aggregation_units: fine-tuned model checkpoint per strategy; benchmark-specific question set or repeated evaluation run; domain and cross-domain averages.
statistical_analysis.denominators: AIME24/AIME25 30 items, AMC23 40, MATH500 500, CodeElo 391, CodeForces 453, LCB old 511/new 369, GPQA 198, JEE 515, HMMT 30, HLE 512.
statistical_analysis.center_and_dispersion: mean accuracy with SEM/standard error; response-length tables use mean token length; AIW uses beta-binomial mean and variance.
statistical_analysis.intervals_tests_multiple_comparisons_boo: No conventional confidence interval, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison correction, bootstrap, Bayesian posterior, regression or correlation model is reported for the main recipe comparisons. Table 1 bolds values within two standard errors.
statistical_analysis.decision_quantities: cross-domain average, domain averages, task accuracy, held-out accuracy, relative degradation, harmfulness/over-refusal rate, correct-response rate and response token length.
statistical_analysis.significance_vs_substantive_vs_mechanism: The paper separates them only partially. It uses two-standard-error visual bolding and says QwQ is statistically significant in Appendix P.6, while most recipe claims are score-ranking decisions; mechanisms remain observational.
